title: Developing an Operational Model for an Internet of Data Based Trusted Data Space for Vocational Education
abstract: arXiv:2611.13520v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Data circulation in vocational education has long been constrained by unclear ownership, a lack of trust, and insufficient incentives. The Internet of Data provides a new underlying technology for enabling trusted cross-domain data circulation. Building on an Internet of Data based trusted data space for vocational education, this paper develops a multi-stakeholder operational model encompassing a value network, a product portfolio, revenue allocation, and governance rules. Emphasizing data sovereignty protection and incentive compatibility, the model provides a reference for the sustainable operation of regional vocational education data ecosystems.

translated_title: 构建基于数联网的职业教育可信数据空间运营模型
translated_abstract: 职业教育中的数据流通长期以来受到权属不清、缺乏信任和激励不足的制约。数联网为实现可信的跨域数据流通提供了新的底层技术。本文在基于数联网的职业教育可信数据空间基础上，构建了一个涵盖价值网络、产品组合、收益分配和治理规则的多方参与运营模型。该模型强调数据主权保护和激励相容，为区域职业教育数据生态系统的可持续运营提供了参考。
tldr: 本文基于数联网技术构建了职业教育可信数据空间的多方运营模型，通过价值网络、产品组合、收益分配和治理规则的系统设计，强调数据主权保护与激励相容，为区域职业教育数据生态系统的可持续运营提供了参考方案。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a multi-stakeholder operational model for an Internet of Data based trusted data space in vocational education, encompassing value networks, product portfolios, revenue allocation, and governance rules, to support the sustainable operation of regional vocational education data ecosystems.
